gates.name: Database linter clean of actionable issues

evidence.note: All 6 WARN findings are the intentional SECURITY DEFINER RBAC/rate-limit primitives (has_role, has_any_role, workspace_role, is_workspace_member, consume_rate_limit, handle_new_user). Required for the RLS bypass pattern; documented in tanstack-supabase-integration and user-roles guidance. Not actionable.

gates.name: Rate-limit adapter fail-closed in production

evidence.behavior: NODE_ENV=production without RATE_LIMIT_ADAPTER=supabase returns { ok:false } and startupDiagnostics surfaces FAIL; releaseCandidateReadiness marks BLOCKED
evidence.runtimeEnforcement: Cloud auto-injects SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY; operator must set RATE_LIMIT_ADAPTER=supabase in RC-1 env

gates.operatorAction: Set RATE_LIMIT_ADAPTER=supabase in the RC-1 deployment environment prior to first live traffic

gates.name: Google OAuth provider ready

evidence.providerEnablement: Requires Lovable Cloud managed OAuth toggle; cannot be enabled from build sandbox without operator confirmation of intent

gates.operatorAction: Enable Google in Cloud → Users → Authentication Settings → Sign In Methods → Google (managed credentials work by default). Verify sign-in on the published preview URL before opening Functional QA.

gates.name: Seed/demo API bearer credentials rotated

evidence.codeGuard: API routes under /api/public/v1 require Bearer with fingerprint match against APIClient row; demo prefix is masked in code and cannot authenticate any real request without a corresponding keyReferenceId row
evidence.productionState: No real APIClient row provisioned in RC-1 env — demo seed does not authenticate

gates.operatorAction: In RC-1: (a) delete APIC-001 or leave disabled, (b) create a new APIClient row per external caller with a fresh secret stored as a runtime secret, (c) issue the new bearer only via Project Settings → Secrets, (d) never distribute the seed prefix.

gates.name: Pre-RC baseline backup + monitoring surface

evidence.governedRestore: performGovernedRestore requires typed 'RESTORE' + ≥8-char reason; auto-snapshots current state; validator regression governedRestoreOk covers path
evidence.monitoringSurface: /admin/monitoring + /admin/deployment render startupDiagnostics(env, snapshot); rate-limit + workspace leakage + audit chain each surface as OK/FAIL rows
evidence.note: Baseline snapshot is an in-environment operation (Repo.exportSnapshot() then Repo.createBackup); cannot be performed from the build sandbox against the RC-1 runtime

gates.operatorAction: In RC-1 preview: sign in as Owner → /admin/backups → Create backup labelled 'pre-rc1-baseline'. Record BKP-id + hash off-platform. Load /admin/monitoring and /admin/deployment; confirm all diagnostics OK before opening QA.
